titleEn: Longest Unequal Adjacent Groups Subsequence II
title: 最长相邻不相等子序列 II
summary: 从 words 中选择最长子序列，要求相邻单词的 groups 不同、长度相等且汉明距离恰好为一，返回任一最长序列。
insight: 把每个单词视作以它结尾的状态。枚举此前单词 j，若组不同且两词只有一个字符不同，就可把 j 的最优序列接到 i；记录长度和前驱后重建全局最长链。
pitfalls: 相邻单词长度必须相等
汉明距离必须恰好为一而非至多一
子序列要保持原下标顺序
多个最长答案可返回任意一个

solutions.title: 二次 DP 与前驱重建
solutions.idea: 检查所有合法前驱并保存最长链。
steps: 对每个 i 枚举 j<i
判断 groups 不同、长度相等、字符差恰好一
若 dp[j]+1 更大则更新 dp[i] 与前驱
沿 previous 回溯并反转单词列表

code.java: class Solution { private boolean adjacent(String a,String b){if(a.length()!=b.length())return false;int differences=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length();i++)if(a.charAt(i)!=b.charAt(i)&&++differences>1)return false;return differences==1;}public List<String> getWordsInLongestSubsequence(String[] words,int[] groups){int n=words.length;int[] dp=new int[n],previous=new int[n];Arrays.fill(dp,1);Arrays.fill(previous,-1);int best=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){for(int j=0;j<i;j++)if(groups[i]!=groups[j]&&adjacent(words[i],words[j])&&dp[j]+1>dp[i]){dp[i]=dp[j]+1;previous[i]=j;}if(dp[i]>dp[best])best=i;}List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int node=best;node!=-1;node=previous[node])answer.add(words[node]);Collections.reverse(answer);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun adjacent(a:String,b:String):Boolean{if(a.length!=b.length)return false;var differences=0;for(i in a.indices)if(a[i]!=b[i]&&++differences>1)return false;return differences==1};fun getWordsInLongestSubsequence(words:Array<String>,groups:IntArray):List<String>{val n=words.size;val dp=IntArray(n){1};val previous=IntArray(n){-1};var best=0;for(i in 0 until n){for(j in 0 until i)if(groups[i]!=groups[j]&&adjacent(words[i],words[j])&&dp[j]+1>dp[i]){dp[i]=dp[j]+1;previous[i]=j};if(dp[i]>dp[best])best=i};val answer=mutableListOf<String>();var node=best;while(node!=-1){answer.add(words[node]);node=previous[node]};answer.reverse();return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool adjacent(string& a,string& b){if(a.size()!=b.size())return false;int differences=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)a.size();++i)if(a[i]!=b[i]&&++differences>1)return false;return differences==1;}public:vector<string> getWordsInLongestSubsequence(vector<string>& words,vector<int>& groups){int n=words.size();vector<int> dp(n,1),previous(n,-1);int best=0;for(int i=0;i<n;++i){for(int j=0;j<i;++j)if(groups[i]!=groups[j]&&adjacent(words[i],words[j])&&dp[j]+1>dp[i]){dp[i]=dp[j]+1;previous[i]=j;}if(dp[i]>dp[best])best=i;}vector<string> answer;for(int node=best;node!=-1;node=previous[node])answer.push_back(words[node]);reverse(answer.begin(),answer.end());return answer;} };
